title: SABRENT USB-C to 2.5Gbps Ethernet Adapter
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B0CXBRNSC4 is the Sabrent NT-25GA USB-C to 2.5Gbps Ethernet adapter; the manufacturer page lists the same model.

comparisons.notes: Manufacturer-direct US offer for one NT-25GA adapter; page shows Add to cart.

writeup: Woot has a new Sabrent USB-C to 2.5Gbps Ethernet adapter, model NT-25GA, for $9.99. Sabrent lists the same single adapter in stock on its own site at $25.99, with Add to cart available. That is about 61 percent below the manufacturer's current price and saves roughly $16. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
